headline: Thunderstorms are holding flights into Newark and delaying them into Chicago.

items.text: The FAA has a ground stop for flights into Newark until 5:15 PM ET because of thunderstorms, and it rates the chance of an extension as medium. Newark is the lowest hub so far, with 41% of departures leaving within 30 minutes of schedule.

The FAA has a ground delay program for flights into Chicago O'Hare until 9:59 PM CT because of thunderstorms, with delays averaging 67 minutes and up to 140 minutes. O'Hare is 48% on time so far today.
87 United departures from its hubs are confirmed canceled today: 41 of 650 at Chicago O'Hare and 30 of 390 at Newark.

Houston has FAA departure delays of 31 to 45 minutes because of thunderstorms, and the FAA says they are increasing; Houston is 66% on time. A ground delay program for flights into Chicago Midway runs until 8:59 PM CT, also because of thunderstorms.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Newark or Chicago O'Hare, check your flight status before leaving for the airport, and do the same for Chicago Midway.
